items.question: أنا موظف جديد، كم يوم إجازة مدفوعة الأجر أستحق في السنة؟
items.notes: Targets the base entitlement, not the 30-day tier that applies only after five continuous years. An answer of 30 with no five-year condition is wrong. Mirrored in English by annual-leave-base-entitlement-en.

items.question: مرضت وأحتاج إلى انقطاع عن العمل — كم يوماً أستحقه براتب كامل؟
items.notes: Same article as sick-leave-three-quarters-tier, different fact. Caution: the article's unpaid third tier is also 30 days, so a wrong answer naming that tier would still match. The word 'كامل' in the question is what forces the right tier; review this item's failures by hand.

items.question: انتهت أول ثلاثين يوماً من انقطاعي بسبب المرض، كم نسبة الراتب بعد ذلك؟
items.notes: Cleanest of the three sick-leave facts: no other tier in the article is three-quarters, so there is no collision.

items.question: صاحب العمل يريد وضعي تحت التجربة — ما أطول مدة يسمح بها النظام؟
items.notes: The article writes the number as (مائة وثمانين); a model may normalise it to 180. Both accepted. This is the same fact the existing smoke test checks, so a failure here also invalidates scripts/smoke_test_rag.py.

items.question: كم ساعة على الأقل يجب أن تكون راحتي الأسبوعية؟
items.notes: Asks for the minimum duration, not which day. The article also names Friday as the default rest day — an answer that says 'Friday' but omits 24 hours has not answered the question.

items.question: ما الحد الأقصى لساعات عملي في اليوم الواحد؟
items.notes: Do not add a bare '8' here: the same article contains 48 (the weekly cap), and '8' is a substring of '48', so a bare '8' would match a wrong answer. Mirrored in English by working-hours-daily-max-en.

items.question: هل تتغير ساعات دوامي في رمضان؟ وكم تصبح؟
items.notes: Same article as working-hours-daily-max, different fact — the Ramadan reduction for Muslim workers. Together these two items check that retrieval finding the article is not confused with the model reading the right sentence inside it.

items.question: اشتغلت ساعات زيادة عن دوامي، كيف تُحسب أجرة الساعات الإضافية؟
items.notes: The article states hour-wage plus 50% of basic wage. A model answering '150% من أجر الساعة' is stating the same fact and still matches on '50' — intentional.

items.question: استقلت بعد ثلاث سنوات، كيف تُحسب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة عن هذه السنوات؟
items.notes: Targets the accrual rate for the first five years (half a month per year), not the one-month rate that applies after. Note this article gives the rate only — the separate reduction for resignation lives in المادة الخامسة والثمانون, covered by resignation-award-fraction.

items.question: إذا استقلت بعد ثلاث سنوات خدمة، هل آخذ المكافأة كاملة؟
items.notes: Deliberately paired with end-of-service-award-first-five-years: same scenario, three years of service, but the correct source article is a different one. A system that retrieves المادة الرابعة والثمانون for both has not understood the question.

items.question: ابني عمره أربعة عشر عاماً، هل يمكن توظيفه؟
items.notes: Phrased as a real situation rather than 'what is the minimum age'. The article also carries a 13-15 light-work exception, so a thorough correct answer may mention both; matching on 15 accepts either.

items.question: زوجتي حامل وتعمل، كم مدة إجازة الوضع المدفوعة؟
items.notes: Twelve weeks at full pay. The article also mentions six mandatory post-birth weeks and optional unpaid extensions; the question asks only for the paid duration. Mirrored in English by maternity-leave-duration-en.

items.question: I just started a new job in Saudi Arabia. How many paid vacation days do I get per year?
items.notes: English twin of annual-leave-base-entitlement. The corpus is entirely Arabic, so this only passes if the embedding model matches across languages. If the Arabic twin passes and this fails, the gap is cross-lingual retrieval, not the law or the chunking.

items.question: What is the maximum number of hours I can be required to work in a single day?
items.notes: English twin of working-hours-daily-max. Same substring trap as the Arabic item — '8' alone would match the article's 48-hour weekly cap, so the unit is required in the match.

items.question: How long is paid maternity leave for a working woman?
items.notes: English twin of maternity-leave-duration. Chosen because the answer is a plain number, so a failure is unambiguous evidence about language handling rather than about legal nuance.
